column6: Say this to the king who like the sun has made the heart of the Land radiant. Repeat it to the one who removed oppressive toil from the furrow, who @varh[t3303.1.v1]{defeated } @vart[t3303.1.v2,t3303.1.v1]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} confronted } @wEN{Tidnum} and holds its sceptre, who is counted as its honoured king. This is what @varh[t3303.1.v3]{@wPN{Lugal-nesaŋe} } @vart[t3303.1.v4,t3303.1.v3]{@varn{2 mss. have instead:} @wPN{Lugal-šu} } , a citizen of @wSN{Nibru} and your servant, says:

A punishment which I do not understand has ravaged me and I have wailed my lamenting. In a strange city I moan like a dove and receive no mercy. I am constantly restless like a dog which does not know where to settle down. I am watchful like a bird which has flown from the claws of a falcon. My exuberance has perished in blight like a garden that has not been @varh[t3303.1.v5]{watered } @vart[t3303.1.v6,t3303.1.v5]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} tended } . Envy within my king's palace overwhelms me and a bad reputation besets me.

Grief ……. Woe ……. Like an ox I am overwhelmed, …… my fodder. My descendants and offspring are on good terms …… their nest, …… the mouth for eating food. @varh[t3303.1.v7]{As happens on } @vart[t3303.1.v8,t3303.1.v7]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} Like a distant …… from } the …… high plains where the winds blow, …… the mill. I will not be buried on dying but …… ground like grain. My brother, although not an enemy, …… contemptuously.
